title: Measures against Night Business Operators Causing Noise Disamenity That Affect Residents
what_it_is: Measures against Night Business Operators Causing Noise Disamenity That Affect Residents

sections.label: Noise action against night operators
sections.summary: Night business operators must meet Public Entertainment licence noise conditions, and Police checks can lead to suspension or revocation of the licence.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs what actions can be taken against night business operators that persistently cause noise disamenity which badly affects residents in a neighbourhood.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They must comply with conditions stipulated in their Public Entertainment licence, or PE licence for short.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These include noise control requirements, for example, ensuring that any amplified sounds emanating from the premises do not exceed 55 A-weighted decibels when measured at the nearest residential dwelling after 10.30 pm.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police conduct regular checks on nightlife establishments to ensure that they comply with the licensing conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Regulatory action will be taken against operators who do not comply with the licensing conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This includes suspending or revoking the operator’s PE licence.

sections.label: Licence assessment and soundproofing requirements
sections.summary: Licence applicants face thorough assessment and requirements such as soundproofing, closed windows and doors, and sound level meters.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Essentially, what we do is that when they apply for such licences, we will do a thorough assessment, looking at how the area is and the feedback received, and there are certain requirements that we also make them fulfill.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For example, they must soundproof their unit and also, in their operations, their windows must all be closed and doors as well, unless there are people going in and out.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: They may also be required to install sound level meters to monitor such noises.
